failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'New York and New Jersey campaign, Battle of Harlem Heights, Battle of White Plains, American Revolutionary War'. Hop 3 returns nearly identical documents to hop 1: both hops retrieve the same Battle of White Plains passage, Battle of Harlem Heights passage, Battle of Pell's Point passage, New York and New Jersey campaign passage, Battle of Mamaroneck passage, and Battle of Long Island passage. The query failed to advance retrieval; summaries already identified the claim error (conflating two battles with different dates), yet hop 3 re-asks for the same entities with identical query structure.
